shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'for f in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then cat "$f"; fi; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/index.js components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css'
/bin/bash -lc 'rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'next/(router|head|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|isFallback|req\\.(query|body)|res\\.(status|json|setHeader)' app components lib types && git diff --check"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore && rg --files app components lib types && ls node_modules/.bin'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
assert.equal(existsSync('pages'), false)
const prerender = JSON.parse(readFileSync('.next/prerender-manifest.json', 'utf8'))
assert.equal(prerender.routes['/blog'].initialRevalidateSeconds, 60)
for (let id = 1; id <= 10; id++) {
  assert.equal(prerender.routes["'`/blog/${id}`].initialRevalidateSeconds, 300)
}
assert.equal(prerender.dynamicRoutes['"'/blog/[id]'].fallback, null)
console.log('PASS pages directory removal, ISR intervals, and blocking on-demand generation')
NODE"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json .gitignore && rg -n '(next/(router|head|document)[\\x27\\x22]|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|isFallback|NextApiRequest|NextApiResponse)' app components lib types tests"
